proposals.after: Wang Yuan met the bandits and did not fight; through association with Kang Lu he obtained Bureau Commissioner.

proposals.before: Feng Yi, Zhang Quwei, Chen Yuan, Gan, Wang Deqian, Guan Li, Dong Songchen
proposals.after: Feng Yi, Zhang Quwei, Chen Yuan, Gan Bian, Wang Deqian, Guan Li, Dong Songchen
proposals.reason: Title list omits 昪 after 甘 in Chinese, but idiomatic correctly has Gan Bian; literal should match the intended name Gan Bian.

decisions.reason: 給事中 is the office title; 宇文價 is the compound surname Yuwen plus Jia. “Zhong Wenzhi” invents a different person and must be corrected to Yuwen Jia.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 給事 中宇文價封還錄黃

decisions.reason: The same unit names 宇文價; the literal’s “Zhong Wenzhi” is the same personal-name error and Yuwen Jia is the accurate replacement.
交康履得樞密 means Wang Yuan gained the Bureau Commissioner post through association with Kang Lu; “handed Kang Lu” misreads 交 as a physical transfer.
The unit string drops 昪 after 甘, but Wikisource’s Songshi vol. 469 heading and biography are 甘昪; restoring Gan Bian matches the intended name already used in the idiomatic field.
